## Vesta v1.1.6

### Combat

- Reworked RCS into a continuous, humanized correction path instead of abrupt compensation steps.
- Added an RCS Smoothness setting and fixed occasional flicks when releasing the fire button.
- Removed residual RCS movement after firing and increased the input update rate for smaller, smoother corrections.
- Improved Aimbot target continuity and removed low-frequency micro-stutter and abrupt recapture movements.
- Separated Fixed, Distance and Target FOV profiles so their settings no longer overwrite each other.
- Added backward-compatible migration for existing FOV configurations.

### Input and compatibility

- Replaced the hard-coded CS2 key mapping with automatic runtime binding resolution.
- Fixed Space being interpreted as Enter, Backspace or another key after game updates.
- Restored Bunnyhop, Edge Jump and automatic Nade Helper jumps.
- Movement automation now pauses while the in-game chat is open, preventing Bunnyhop, Edge Jump, Nade Helper and Auto Stop from injecting keys into chat input.
- Invalid binding layouts now fail safely instead of injecting an incorrect key.

### Visuals

- Fixed Legit Sync opacity not being applied to GPU Chams and their bloom passes.
- Legit Sync fading now affects Player ESP, Chams, offscreen arrows, bloom and related indicators consistently.
- Directly visible players remain fully opaque while indirect radar or sound information uses the configured pulse.

### Configurations

- Updated Full Legit, Legit and Semi Rage with the new humanized aiming profile.
- Aimbot and RCS remain disabled by default but are fully preconfigured.
- Added RCS Smoothness to configuration serialization.
- Fixed and Distance FOV default to 2 degrees; Target FOV scales from 20 degrees nearby to 2 degrees at distance.
